zakatSection.title: Zakat, calculated correctly.

wealth.sectionDescription: Select which accounts to include in your Zakat calculation. By default, all accounts are included.

nisab.label: Nisab threshold
nisab.helperText: The minimum wealth threshold above which Zakat becomes obligatory. Traditionally calculated as the value of 85g of gold or 595g of silver.
nisab.referenceFooter: Verify current values with your local Zakat authority. These are reference figures only — your authority is the source of truth.

result.belowNisabMessage: Zakat is not yet obligatory on this amount.

actions.createGoalSuccess: Zakat goal created in your Goals page

disclaimer.title: About this calculator
disclaimer.body: This calculator uses standard cash Zakat rules under the Shafi'i school of jurisprudence (the dominant madhab in Southeast Asia). The calculation assumes the wealth has been held above nisab for one full hijri year (haul). For complex situations involving business assets, agricultural produce, debts owed to you, or different schools of jurisprudence, please consult your local Zakat authority.
